purpose: TC-Stereo as the integrated-architecture reference on identical frames and GT

temporal_path_disabled.reason: its propagation warps the previous disparity by a rigid 6-DoF reprojection from per-frame pose, intrinsics and baseline; SCARED-C provides no per-frame pose and deformable tissue is not rigid
temporal_path_disabled.consequence: this is TC-Stereo's single-frame stereo path, reported as an integrated-architecture reference and not as a temporal rival
